analysis: Protein disulfide bridge bonds play a crucial role in maintaining the tertiary structure of proteins by forming covalent bonds between cysteine residues. These bonds are strong and are not easily broken by treatments like 8M urea or dialysis. Betamercaptoethane can break these bonds by reducing the disulfide bridges.
